exposure: Third-trimester ultrasound diagnosis of large for gestational age (LGA)
outcome: Nulliparous term singleton vertex (NTSV) CD rate
cohort: Patients who underwent a clinically indicated third-trimester ultrasound between January 2017 and July 2021, divided into those diagnosed with an LGA fetus and those without.
finding: A third-trimester ultrasound diagnosis of large for gestational age (LGA) independently increases the odds of cesarean delivery, specifically among nulliparous patients.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in the rates of non-medically indicated CD, multiparous primary CD, or attempted and successful TOLAC associated with an LGA diagnosis.
birth_weight: Ultrasound-estimated fetal weight greater than or equal to the 90th percentile for gestational age (LGA)
